name: MOSS-TTS-Nano-API
description: OpenAI-compatible TTS API powered by MOSS-TTS-Nano (100M params, Fudan OpenMOSS). 20 languages, 48kHz stereo, voice cloning, CPU-capable. Ultra-lightweight — can run alongside other GPU services without conflict. First start downloads model from HuggingFace. China users: set HF_ENDPOINT to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads. Works with or without GPU.

paths.name: Model Cache
paths.description: Model download cache. Persists across container recreates.

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: OpenAI-compatible TTS API port. Swagger docs at /docs

variables.name: Device
variables.description: Compute device: auto (GPU if available, else CPU), cuda:0, or cpu.

variables.name: Default Voice
variables.description: Default voice preset when none specified. Options: zh_1-zh_6, en_1-en_5, jp_1-jp_5, etc.

variables.name: HuggingFace Endpoint
variables.description: HuggingFace download endpoint. China users: change to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads.
